mapper.insert: INSERT INTO new_contract.underwriting_batch_execution (batch_execution_id, business_date, trigger_type, process_status, started_at) VALUES (#{executionId}, #{executionDate}, #{triggerType}, 'P', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.update: UPDATE new_contract.underwriting_batch_request r JOIN new_contract.insurance_application a ON a.application_no = r.application_no SET r.process_status = 'P', r.claimed_by_execution_id = #{executionId} WHERE a.application_status = 'PW' AND r.requested_business_date = #{executionDate} AND r.process_status = 'W' AND r.claimed_by_execution_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT r.batch_request_id, a.application_no, a.application_id, a.application_revision, a.application_date, a.requested_effective_date, a.application_status, a.product_code, a.product_version, a.currency_code, a.sum_assured_amount, a.premium_amount, a.policy_no, a.initial_premium_match_status, MAX(u.underwriting_case_no) AS underwriting_case_no, MAX(CASE WHEN p.party_role_code = 'APPLICANT' THEN p.customer_id END) AS applicant_customer_id, MAX(CASE WHEN p.party_role_code = 'INSURED' THEN p.customer_id END) AS insured_customer_id FROM new_contract.underwriting_batch_request r JOIN new_contract.insurance_application a ON a.application_no = r.application_no LEFT JOIN new_contract.application_party p ON p.application_no = a.application_no LEFT JOIN new_contract.underwriting_case u ON u.application_no = a.application_no WHERE r.claimed_by_execution_id = #{executionId} AND r.process_status = 'P' GROUP BY r.batch_request_id, a.application_no, a.application_id, a.application_revision, a.application_date, a.requested_effective_date, a.application_status, a.product_code, a.product_version, a.currency_code, a.sum_assured_amount, a.premium_amount, a.policy_no, a.initial_premium_match_status ORDER BY r.requested_at, r.batch_request_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO new_contract.underwriting_case (underwriting_case_no, application_no, underwriting_status, underwriting_decision_code, underwriter_id, decision_reason_code, underwritten_at, policy_no) VALUES (#{caseNo}, #{applicationNo}, #{status}, #{decisionCode}, 'SCHEDULED-BATCH', #{reasonCode}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), #{policyNo}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE underwriting_status = VALUES(underwriting_status), underwriting_decision_code = VALUES(underwriting_decision_code), underwriter_id = VALUES(underwriter_id), decision_reason_code = VALUES(decision_reason_code), underwritten_at = VALUES(underwritten_at), policy_no = COALESCE(policy_no, VALUES(policy_no)), record_version = record_version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.update: UPDATE new_contract.underwriting_batch_request SET process_status = #{status}, result_code = #{resultCode}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE batch_request_id = #{requestId} AND process_status = 'P'

UPDATE new_contract.insurance_application SET application_status = #{applicationStatus}, validation_result_status = #{status}, validation_completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), validation_batch_id = #{executionId}, record_version = record_version + 1, updated_by = 'SCHEDULED-BATCH', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE application_no = #{applicationNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO main.policy_contract (policy_contract_id, policy_no, source_application_id, application_no, underwriting_case_no, product_code, product_version, policy_status, currency_code, sum_assured_amount, premium_amount, effective_date, contract_date) SELECT #{policyContractId}, #{policyNo}, a.application_id, a.application_no, #{caseNo}, a.product_code, a.product_version, 'ACTIVE', a.currency_code, a.sum_assured_amount, a.premium_amount, a.requested_effective_date, CURRENT_DATE FROM new_contract.insurance_application a WHERE a.application_no = #{applicationNo} AND a.application_status = 'PW'

INSERT INTO main.policy_party (policy_party_id, policy_no, party_role_code, party_seq, customer_id, relationship_to_insured_code, customer_snapshot_reference) SELECT UUID(), #{policyNo}, party_role_code, party_seq, customer_id, relationship_to_insured_code, customer_snapshot_reference FROM new_contract.application_party WHERE application_no = #{applicationNo}

INSERT INTO main.policy_coverage (policy_coverage_id, policy_no, coverage_item_seq, coverage_item_type, product_code, product_version, insured_customer_id, currency_code, sum_assured_amount, premium_amount, effective_date, end_date, coverage_status) SELECT UUID(), #{policyNo}, coverage_item_seq, coverage_item_type, product_code, product_version, insured_customer_id, currency_code, sum_assured_amount, premium_amount, requested_effective_date, requested_end_date, 'ACTIVE' FROM new_contract.application_coverage WHERE application_no = #{applicationNo}

INSERT INTO main.policy_beneficiary (policy_beneficiary_id, policy_no, beneficiary_type_code, beneficiary_seq, beneficiary_customer_id, beneficiary_designation_code, priority_no, allocation_percentage, relationship_to_insured_code) SELECT UUID(), #{policyNo}, beneficiary_type_code, beneficiary_seq, beneficiary_customer_id, beneficiary_designation_code, priority_no, allocation_percentage, relationship_to_insured_code FROM new_contract.application_beneficiary WHERE application_no = #{applicationNo}

INSERT INTO new_contract.business_audit_event (audit_event_id, operation_type, operator_id, request_id, application_no, underwriting_case_no, result_code, occurred_at) VALUES (#{auditId}, 'UNDERWRITING_BATCH', 'SCHEDULED-BATCH', #{executionId}, #{applicationNo}, #{caseNo}, #{resultCode}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.update: UPDATE new_contract.underwriting_batch_execution SET process_status = #{executionStatus}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), total_count = #{totalCount}, approved_count = #{approvedCount}, inquiry_count = #{inquiryCount}, failed_count = #{failedCount} WHERE batch_execution_id = #{executionId} AND process_status = 'P'
